chunks: Muhammad b. al-Hasan (may God be pleased with him) narrated to us. He said: Al-Hasan b. Matil al-Daqqaq narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. al-Husayn b. Abi al-Khattab narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. Sinan narrated to us, from Abu al-Jarud Ziyad b. al-Mundhir, from Abu Ja'far Muhammad b. Ali al-Baqir (peace be upon him). He said: I heard Jabir b. Abdullah al-Ansari saying that the Messenger of God (may God bless him and his family)

was in the house of Umm Ibrahim one day, and a group of his companions was with him, when Ali b. Abi Talib (peace be upon him) came forward. When the Prophet (may God bless him and his family) saw him, he said: O assembly of people! The best of people after me has come forward to you, and he is your master. Obedience to him is obligatory like obedience to me, and disobeying him is prohibited like disobeying me. O people! I am the House of Wisdom and Ali is its key. The house cannot be reached except by the key. And whoever alleges that he loves me yet hates Ali has lied.

key_terms.خير الناس: The best of people - a superlative title given to Ali by the Prophet
key_terms.دار الحكمة: House of Wisdom (Dar al-Hikmah) - a metaphor the Prophet used for himself, with Ali as its key
key_terms.مولاكم: Your master (Mawlakum) - a title denoting leadership and authority

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet say about Ali being the key to the House of Wisdom?
ai.summary: The Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) was in the house of Umm Ibrahim with some companions when Ali b. Abi Talib (AS) came forward. The Prophet declared Ali as the best of people after him, their master whose obedience is obligatory like the Prophet's own and whose disobedience is prohibited like disobeying the Prophet. He proclaimed himself the House of Wisdom and Ali its key, stating that one cannot reach the house except through the key, and that whoever claims to love the Prophet but hates Ali is a liar.

en.bilal-muhammad: Muhammad b. al-Hasan (ra) narrated to us. He said: Al-Hasan b. Matil al-Daqqaq narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. al-Husayn b. Abi’l Khattab narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. Sinan narrated to us from Abi’l Jarud Ziyad b. al-Mundhir from Abi Ja`far Muhammad b. `Ali al-Baqir (as). He said: I heard Jabir b. `Abdullah al-Ansari say: The Messenger of Allah (s)

was in the house of Umm Ibrahim one day, and a delegation of his companions was with him. `Ali b. Abi Talib (as) came forward. When the Prophet (s) saw him, he said: O people! The best of people after me has come forward to you. He is your Master. Obedience to him is an obligation, just like obedience to me. Disobeying him is prohibited, just like disobeying me. O people! I am the House of Wisdom and `Ali is its Key, and the house cannot be sought except by the key. He who alleges to love me yet hates `Ali has lied.
